messages:
Maria (Partnerships): Hey team — publisher AcmeAI is ready for initial cloud storefront activation. Goals: entitlements mapping, trial gating, and privacy signoff. Can we run a quick triage?
Tom R (CloudOps): Got it. Do we have their onboarding spreadsheet? I need the expected API endpoints and whether they require cross-account S3 access.
Maria (Partnerships): Added the sheet: https://acmeai.example/onboard (private link). They have a demo bucket + a metrics webhook. No cross-account writes, just reads.
Anika (Legal): Quick Q on telemetry: will usage events include user email or customer IDs? If yes we need a dataflow diagram and retention policy.
Kevin (Product): They want a 14-day trial SKU with seat-based limits and discounted overage. Need packaging details to map to our entitlement model.
Jia (Engineering): For the entitlement side we can create a trial SKU fingerprint that ties to tenant_id + trial_expiry. Suggest implementing 2 fields: `trial_expiry` and `seat_limit`.
Tom R (CloudOps): For IAM, we should provide a minimal read-only role. Proposed role name: `redwood-pub-acmeai-readonly`. Sharing snippet for their infra team:
```
Role: redwood-pub-acmeai-readonly
Permissions: s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket (filtered to demo bucket)
Trust: publisher-account-id
```
Maria (Partnerships): tagging @Anika — publisher confirmed no PII in events, only anonymized hashes + app_version. Anika, does that change the review?
Anika (Legal): Good, hashes are fine but we still need the retention window and opt-out flow. Please ask them to confirm retention = 30 days max. Also send the publisher addendum PDF for signatures.
Kevin (Product): On packaging, we'll expose two SKUs: `acmeai-core` (metered per request) and `acmeai-trial-14d` (free for 14 days). Need pricing band suggestions — Jill from pricing prefers 3 tiers: dev, team, enterprise.
Maria (Partnerships): I'll loop in pricing afterwards. For marketplace metadata: short description, 2 screenshots, logo (512x512 png), and a privacy summary paragraph. I asked AcmeAI for assets, ETA EOD tomorrow.
listing-bot: Automated check: manifest.json missing required field `privacy_summary` — see https://redwood.infra/listing-checks/1728576000
Jia (Engineering): I'll run the manifest validator once assets are in. Also can we add an integration test in staging for token exchange? Sample cURL we can give them:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/exchange -d '{"publisher_token":"<token>"}'
```
Tom R (CloudOps): Staging provisioning note: publisher sandbox will be created in us-west-2. If they need EU data residency we'll schedule a separate run.
Anika (Legal): Once I get the retention confirmation and signed addendum, I'll clear legal. Please keep the addendum and contract versions in the shared folder.
Maria (Partnerships): Plan: 1) Get assets + retention confirmation (AcmeAI) 2) CloudOps creates IAM role + staging sandbox 3) Eng runs validation + test token exchange 4) Legal signs addendum 5) Product finalizes SKU tiers. I put these in the shared checklist. Anyone objections? :thumbsup:
Kevin (Product): :thumbsup: No objections. If pricing needs concrete numbers I'll ping Jill.
Jia (Engineering): Working on the validator today, will update when manifest passes.
Tom R (CloudOps): I'll provision the role tomorrow morning and post the IAM ARN here.
Anika (Legal): Will review addendum once uploaded.
Maria (Partnerships): Great — target soft-publish to staging next week. Thanks all.
